name: software_cupti
description: CUPTI (CUDA Profiling Tools Interface) as dftracer's NVIDIA GPU tracing backend: which CUPTI API dftracer uses (Activity API only: a timeline, not hardware counters), where cupti.h/libcupti.so live in the two CUDA toolkit layouts, building with DFTRACER_ENABLE_CUDA_TRACING (an env var for setup.py, not CMAKE_ARGS) and DFTRACER_CUDA_PATH, the versioned activity-record struct bands per toolkit, clock rebasing onto the dftracer timeline, the CUDA event taxonomy, dropped-record warnings, and the run-time gates (one CUPTI client per process, NVreg_RestrictProfilingToAdminUsers). Load for any DFTRACER_ENABLE_CUDA_TRACING build, any NVIDIA-GPU dftracer session, or on: no CUDA events in the trace / no 'found CUPTI at' configure line, 'CUPTI_ERROR_INSUFFICIENT_PRIVILEGES', 'CUPTI dropped N activity records', 'unknown type CUpti_ActivityKernelN', GPU events at absurd timestamps, nsys/ncu/torch.profiler failing to attach, find reporting no cupti.h.
